tiers.name: induction
tiers.description: Requires structural induction on Nat or List

theorems.statement: theorem pf_t3_01 (n : Nat) : n + 0 = n := by
theorems.known_proof:
induction n with
| zero => rfl
| succ n ih => simp [Nat.succ_add, ih]

theorems.statement: theorem pf_t3_02 : ∀ n : Nat, 0 + n = n := by
theorems.known_proof:
intro n; induction n with
| zero => rfl
| succ n ih => simp [Nat.succ_add, ih]

theorems.statement: theorem pf_t3_03 (l : List Nat) : l.length ≥ 0 := by
theorem pf_t3_04 (l : List α) : [].append l = l := by
theorem pf_t3_05 (n : Nat) : n + Nat.succ 0 = Nat.succ n := by
theorem pf_t3_06 (n : Nat) : Nat.succ n ≠ 0 := by
theorems.known_proof: intro h; exact absurd h (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)

theorems.statement: theorem pf_t3_07 (n : Nat) : n + 1 = Nat.succ n := by
theorem pf_t3_08 (a b : Nat) : a + Nat.succ b = Nat.succ (a + b) := by

theorem pf_t3_10 (a b c : Nat) : (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c := by

tiers.name: multi_step
tiers.description: Requires combining multiple tactics or term-mode proofs

theorems.statement: theorem pf_t4_01 (p q r : Prop) : (p → q) → (q → r) → p → r := by
theorems.known_proof: intro hpq hqr hp; exact hqr (hpq hp)

theorems.statement: theorem pf_t4_02 (p q : Prop) : (p ∧ q) → (q ∧ p) := by
theorem pf_t4_03 (p q : Prop) : p ∨ q → q ∨ p := by
theorems.known_proof:
intro h; cases h with
| inl hp => right; exact hp
| inr hq => left; exact hq

theorems.statement: theorem pf_t4_04 (p q r : Prop) : p ∧ (q ∨ r) → (p ∧ q) ∨ (p ∧ r) := by
theorems.known_proof:
intro ⟨hp, hqr⟩; cases hqr with
| inl hq => left; exact ⟨hp, hq⟩
| inr hr => right; exact ⟨hp, hr⟩

theorems.statement: theorem pf_t4_05 (n m : Nat) : n ≤ m → n ≤ m + 1 := by
theorem pf_t4_06 (n : Nat) : n = 0 ∨ ∃ m, n = Nat.succ m := by
theorems.known_proof:
cases n with
| zero => left; rfl
| succ m => right; exact ⟨m, rfl⟩

theorems.statement: theorem pf_t4_07 (p : Prop) : ¬(p ∧ ¬p) := by
theorem pf_t4_08 (a b : Nat) : a ≤ b → b ≤ a → a = b := by
theorem pf_t4_09 (f : α → β) (a b : α) : a = b → f a = f b := by
theorem pf_t4_10 (p q : Prop) : ¬(p ∨ q) → ¬p ∧ ¬q := by
theorems.known_proof: intro h; exact ⟨fun hp => h (Or.inl hp), fun hq => h (Or.inr hq)⟩
